answer: Sybil farms mint many cheap voters. Here a berth requires one hull: lock 37 units for a unique plate, then prove presence at a single assigned delta gauge (G=H(plate||day) mod 36) by holding 140 seconds of draft telemetry that begins at local solar zenith along the named river reach. The barge first commits H(silt||plate); after the hold, two gauges open the commitment. Reused plates, holds under 140s, or silt mismatches are dropped. Missing the zenith slot costs 12 units and a 6-epoch bench; a gauge that countersigns two plates in one slot pays 55 units and stays dark 9 epochs.
